page.layout: One text column of dictionary entries under a running head; page number at top right. Show-through from the reverse page is faint in the margins and is omitted.

main_text.p: פלא פְּלָא Ch. Provincia, Tractus, Regio: Item Scipio, Baculus. Plur. פְּלָכִין, פְּלָכְיָא.

תְּפִלָּא Ch. Phylacterium, frontale, manuale, membrana, quam oraturi Judæi, fronti & brachio sinistro applicant, ab Hebr. תְּפִלָּה Oratio, quasi Oratorium dixeris, Exo.39.31. in Jon. & Deut.11.18. in eodem. Plur. תְּפִלִין, Syr. cum Aff. ܬܦܝܠܬܗܘܢ Phylacteria sua, Matth.23.5.
מְפוּלָם Ch. Forte, Recens: Plur. אַבְנִין מְפוּלָמָן Lapides recentes, fortes, Jobi 28.3.
פּוֹלְמוֹס Ch. Bellum, Exercitus, Græc. πόλεμος. Plur. פּוֹלְמוֹסִין.
פּוּלְמַרְכִּין Chald. Præfecti, Principes, Duces exercitus, πολέμαρχοι.
פְּלוֹן Syr. Aliquis, ὁ δεῖνα, Hebr. פְּלוֹנִי, Matthæi.26.18.
פֵּלֶם פֵּילָם Ch. Pondus, Libra, 1.Sam.30.12. Item Siclus, Ezech.4.10.
פְּלַע Syr. Oportunitas, Oportunum tempus, Occasio, Matth.26.16.
פַּלְקָתָא Ch. Concubina, pellex, pallaca, Græc. παλλακή, vel παλλακίς, Hebr. פִּילֶגֶשׁ.

פָּלַשׁ Syr. Fodere, effodere, perfodere, Matth.6.19. Convenit cum בָּלַשׁ. Ethpeh. Futur. יִתְפַּלַּשׁ Ut perfodiatur, Lucæ 12.39. Deinde Chald. אִתְפְּלַשׁ, Volvere, Volutare vel conspergere se, ut Hebr. Mich.1.10.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; the Syriac forms in entries "Phylacteria" and "Oportunum" and some vowel pointing are uncertain. The Greek in the "Bellum" and "Praefecti" entries is approximate.
